alignment.dates_aligned_note: the two curves are from different dates and neither is moved to the other's date
alignment.method: period index to period index, no shift, no resampling

date_rule.rule: cross-date pairing allowed; both dates recorded

industry_aggregation.method: per-slot average active power, converted once per meter-day and summed by user then by bus
industry_aggregation.note: a slot reading is a mean power, not an energy, so no 60/SLOT_MINUTES factor is applied; see S1 and reports/industry_load_rebuild.md
industry_aggregation.reading_conversion: value x 综合倍率 -> kW, / 1000 -> MW

price_source.date_is: parsed from the sheet name's own YY/MM/DD label

checks.optimality_gap_note: continuous SOCP: no MIP gap; a final OPTIMAL status means the objective bound equals the incumbent

fleet.optimality_gap_note: continuous SOCP: no MIP gap; a final OPTIMAL status means the objective bound equals the incumbent

solver.duals_note: whether a power-balance dual was available for every period; a dual is what an LMP is, so False means some price fell back to the wholesale curve rather than being nodal
